audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contains no numbers; two Do's/Don'ts bodies are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles; anti-heal timing vs Ravenous Flock is only glancingly present.
audit.why: Swain E (Nevermove) is 12s at rank 1 and his R is 120s — the punish windows the page never quantifies. His E is a projectile-class returning wave that roots; dodging it stalls his engage and Soul Fragment income. Syndra QE stuns through his fly-in.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns; bleed bullets rewritten to match their titles.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Check it before every step-up. - E Scatter the Weak is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension is a 120s cooldown — disengage when it starts, commit hard while it is down. Nevermove runs 12s at rank 1: the ten seconds after he whiffs it are free poke. Your own E is 15s — keep it for his fly-in, never for damage.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Grounded spheres are instant QE stuns and R damage at once — two banked near the wave means his 850-range Nevermove step-up is a trap, not an engage.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: His W scans fog from 5500+ range and every champion hit feeds him a Soul Fragment — an unwarded push past river hands Swain vision, stacks, and the gank all at once.

edits.before: Track Swain’s Demonic Ascension: His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Demonic Ascension (120s): disengage when it starts, all-in while it is down. Nevermove is a returning wave — sidestep it and his pull, stacks, and all-in stall together.
